items.title: Atomberg Fan Remote & Widgets
items.description:
Lost your Atomberg remote? Broken controller or dead batteries? 

Control your Atomberg ceiling, pedestal, and wall fans instantly using your smartphone’s built-in IR (Infrared) blaster! 

Atomberg Fan Remote is a fast, hyper-realistic, and beautifully crafted remote controller app designed specifically for Atomberg BLDC fans. Experience instant response with zero pairing, authentic tactile haptic feedback, and interactive Home Screen Widgets that let you change fan speeds without even opening the app!

==================================
⚡ WHY CHOOSE ATOMBERG FAN REMOTE?
==================================

📱 EXCLUSIVE HOME SCREEN WIDGETS
Control your fan right from your Android home screen! Choose from multiple clean widget sizes (2x2, 3x2, 2x3, 3x3) to power on/off, change speeds, trigger boost, or set timers with a single tap.

🚀 INSTANT PLUG & PLAY — ZERO PAIRING
No Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, or complex account setup required. Just point your phone’s IR blaster at the fan and press any button — it works exactly like the original physical remote.

🎛️ COMPLETE REMOTE CONTROL COMMANDS
• Power: Turn your fan ON or OFF with a single tap.
• Speed 1 to 6: Direct one-touch buttons for every speed setting.
• BOOST Mode: Activate maximum RPM and peak airflow instantly.
• SLEEP Mode: Comfortably graduate speed downward throughout the night.
• TIMER Mode: Set automated 1-hour, 2-hour, 3-hour, or 6-hour sleep timers to save electricity.
• OSCILLATION / SWING: Toggle smooth oscillation for Atomberg Pedestal and Wall fans.
• LED LIGHT: Instant light on/off toggle for Atomberg Studio and light-equipped fans.

✨ PREMIUM TACTILE & VISUAL EXPERIENCE
• Haptic Vibrations: Realistic tactile feedback with every button press.
• Animated Speed Visualizer: Live rotating fan blades reflect your exact speed in real time.
• Modern Ergonomic Design: High-contrast buttons tailored for effortless one-handed use in low-light bedrooms.

==================================
🌬️ SUPPORTED ATOMBERG FAN MODELS
==================================

Compatible with all Atomberg BLDC motor fans featuring infrared receivers:
• Atomberg Renesa & Renesa+ (1200mm, 900mm, 600mm)
• Atomberg Efficio & Efficio+
• Atomberg Studio & Studio+ (including LED light models)
• Atomberg Aris & Aris Starlight
• Atomberg Pedestal Fans (with Oscillation & Swing control)
• Atomberg Wall Mount Fans
• Atomberg Gorilla BLDC series

==================================
🔧 HOW TO USE
==================================

1. Ensure your Android smartphone has a built-in IR Blaster (Infrared sensor).
2. Open Atomberg Fan Remote.
3. Point your phone toward your Atomberg fan sensor.
4. Tap Power or any Speed button (1-6) to control your fan immediately!

==================================
📡 DEVICE REQUIREMENTS
==================================

⚠️ IMPORTANT HARDWARE NOTICE:
This application operates exclusively via Infrared (IR). Your smartphone MUST have a built-in IR Blaster (hardware sensor). 
Supported phone brands include:
• Xiaomi / Redmi / POCO (all models with IR)
• Vivo / iQOO (models with IR)
• Oppo / Realme (models with IR)
• Huawei / Honor
• Older Samsung Galaxy and HTC models with IR emitters

If your smartphone does not have an IR emitter sensor, the app will notify you upon launch.

==================================
⚖️ DISCLAIMER
==================================

This application is an independent utility developed for users who have lost or damaged their physical fan remote. This app is NOT an official application of Atomberg Technologies Pvt. Ltd., and is neither affiliated with, sponsored by, nor endorsed by Atomberg Technologies Pvt. Ltd. All trademarks, model names, and registered logos are property of their respective owners.
